title: Fail-closed runtime environment identity parity across Staging and Production

phases.objective: Make runtime environment class an explicit, observable, fail-closed deployment invariant so a correct SHA and branch cannot be mistaken for a certified Staging or Production runtime when the concrete deployment class is ambiguous.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: runtimeEnvironmentResolver, /deployment-info, Production R7, and Production Runtime Parity Evidence
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging certifies only staging_local_windows_docker and Production certifies only production_hostinger_autodeploy; generic production/prod/staging signals remain insufficient for privileged runtime-class certification, while all readback evidence remains bounded and secret-free.
steps: Resolve environment family and runtime class from one canonical runtime-environment policy without treating generic production/prod aliases as explicit Hostinger identity.
Pin the local Docker Staging process to staging_local_windows_docker in Compose as well as the local env template authority.
Expose sanitized strict runtime-environment evidence in /deployment-info without returning raw environment values.
Require Production certification to consume only canonical deployment-manifest SHA/branch provenance, matching Recovery bootstrap requireManifest=true semantics.
Require Production R7 to prove exact Production SHA, Production branch, and explicit production_hostinger_autodeploy runtime class before production_current can be true.
Require Production Runtime Parity Evidence to validate both /version and /deployment-info and fail closed when runtime identity is ambiguous even if SHA and branch are current.
Declare exact runtime-environment requirements in deployment-branch-policy for both Staging and Production.
Preserve cross-environment conflict rejection and all existing Recovery, approval, ticket, database, and provider boundaries.
assertions: DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=production_hostinger_autodeploy is required for runtime_class_explicit=true in Production.
NODE_ENV=production or REMOTE_MCP_ENVIRONMENT=production alone remains runtime_class_ambiguous.
DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT=staging_local_windows_docker is the canonical local Staging runtime variant.
Conflicting Staging and Production signals fail with runtime_environment_conflict.
/deployment-info returns only classification metadata, signal key names, and false secret/raw-value attestations; environment values are not exposed.
Production R7 and Production Runtime Parity reject current SHA/branch when runtime class is not explicit.
Production R7 and Runtime Parity reject fallback-only deployment identity when gitCommitFull/gitBranch canonical manifest evidence is absent.
No Production deployment, restart, database mutation, migration apply, grant apply, provider mutation, credential mutation, or secret read is performed by this repository patch.

Every changed critical runtime-identity governance path is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths; broad patterns and autonomous merge remain forbidden.

phases.objective: After merge and governed deployment configuration, prove live Production reports production_hostinger_autodeploy and live Staging reports staging_local_windows_docker before resuming Recovery Control Store planning.
